card.name: Key noun in famous quotations
card.fires_on: The key noun or verb inside a well-known quotation, proverb or scripture line, where the next words are highly predictable. Examples are 'fall short of the glory' and 'in all his glory'.

modes.label: Scripture and proverbs
modes.description: A noun in a familiar Bible verse or saying, just before the verse finishes.
modes.example: "For all have sinned and fall short of the<< glory>> of God."

modes.label: Famous quotes
modes.description: A content word in a quote from a famous author or thinker.
modes.example: In the middle of difficulty<< lies>> opportunity. -- Albert Einstein

modes.label: Stock warning phrase
modes.description: The final noun of a fixed warning sentence on a label.
modes.example: WARNING Keep out of the reach of<< children>>. In case of accidental overdose, seek
